avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces ibrutinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; substitute with alternative if depression treatment needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract/Seed
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases ibrutinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; counsel on grapefruit-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxic supplement may potentiate ibrutinib-related liver injury
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; monitor liver function tests baseline and periodically

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase bleeding risk synergistically with ibrutinib's antiplatelet effects
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU/day; monitor for bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Garlic Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction and antiplatelet effects may modestly reduce ibrutinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; maintain consistent intake if used

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase ibrutinib concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity; adjust ibrutinib timing if needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild hepatic enzyme modulation; limited clinical interaction data
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor liver enzymes and ibrutinib efficacy

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Pomelo
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases ibrutinib bioavailability and toxicity risk significantly
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; educate on all citrus variants containing furanocoumarins

avoid_foods.name: High-fat Meals (>50g fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases ibrutinib absorption unpredictably; may elevate plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Take ibrutinib consistently with or without food; avoid variable fat intake patterns

caution_foods.name: Cranberry Juice (high quantity)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition; antiplatelet properties may synergize with drug
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation (<8 oz/day); monitor for bleeding

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (excessive intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Indole-3-carbinol may induce CYP3A4 at very high consumption levels
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary intake acceptable; counsel against supplemental or concentrated forms

monitoring_notes: Ibrutinib has narrow therapeutic index and significant CYP3A4/P-gp dependence; counsel on consistent food/supplement habits to maintain stable levels. Monitor CBC, liver/renal function, and bleeding signs regularly, especially if CYP3A4 modulators are introduced.
